scripts.build: npm run sync && astro build && node scripts/post-build.mjs && node scripts/og.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node hub/build.mjs && wrangler deploy && wrangler deploy --config hub/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dry-run: npm run build && node hub/build.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/out && wrangler deploy --config hub/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/hub-out
